sources.observation: A broad ribbed hipped roof shades the raised wooden porch. The central stair has volcanic-stone cheeks and the veranda bays have light diamond grilles.

sources.observation: One recessed gallery facade is pale moss green with a deep, square-edged canopy.

limitations: The veranda and roof profiles use exterior photos. Gallery glazing and detailing outside the principal elevation are approximated.
